title: Knowledge check: Introduction to DOM Traversal

questions.prompt: Which principle best guides a correct implementation of introduction to dom traversal?
options: Load multiple library copies and rely on whichever one executes last.
Traversal starts from an existing selection and moves through its ancestors, descendants, or siblings. Scope traversal to the component you mean instead of repeating broad document-wide queries.
Skip error handling and assume the default browser state is always correct.
Render user-controlled strings as HTML so the browser can infer their meaning.
questions.answer_key: Traversal starts from an existing selection and moves through its ancestors, descendants, or siblings. Scope traversal to the component you mean instead of repeating broad document-wide queries.
questions.explanation: Traversal starts from an existing selection and moves through its ancestors, descendants, or siblings. Scope traversal to the component you mean instead of repeating broad document-wide queries. Apply this principle with the API/version documentation linked in the lesson.
